description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class LeaveStatusChange within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. The class models an event triggered when the status of leave requests changes, encapsulating relevant data such as leave requests, the workflow state machine, and the user performing the action.

classes.name: LeaveStatusChange
classes.description: An abstract event class representing a change in leave status, encapsulating leaves involved, workflow state, and the performer.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the leave requests, workflow, and user performer associated with the leave status change event.

methods.name: getLeaves
methods.description: Returns the array of Leave objects associated with this event.

methods.name: getWorkflow
methods.description: Returns the WorkflowStateMachine object associated with this event.

methods.name: getPerformer
methods.description: Returns the User object who performed the leave status change.
